Subject: SIG intake: completion request and artifact deadline

We're preparing Finlytics' vendor packet for next-week procurement review. Can Redwood provide the completed SIG (Standardized Information Gathering) spreadsheet and the network diagram by COB May 3? Our security operations team needs the artifacts uploaded to our portal for pre-review.

Key asks:
- Completed SIG (all questions answered)
- Network diagram (Zoned diagram + public/private subnet callouts)
- Attestation or contact for SOC 2 status and evidence delivery cadence

If you have a partial drop earlier, please share — we can begin intake and flag any gaps.

Thanks,
Helen Park

Finlytics Inc.

I reviewed the draft SIG spreadsheet — a couple of technical clarifications we should call out for Finlytics: 

- Q3.2.4 (Key rotation): Our rotation cadence for service account keys is 90 days; customer-managed keys (BYOK) supported via KMS integrations depending on deployment mode.
- Q5.1.1 (Data retention): Default retention is 30 days for ephemeral request logs in Hosted mode; Dedicated/Private customers can extend via config.
- Q6.4 (Network segmentation): network-diagram-v2.pdf covers subnet zoning (public ingestion / compute / management plane). I'll attach a short PKI/rotation evidence packet by May 2.

I'll also prepare a signed attestation template to confirm SOC 2 timeline and where to expect the report. If Finlytics needs a named contact for audits, propose we provide our Security Engineering lead for the review window.

-Karthik
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
